lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 18-22 high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the five gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the blob constellation to form a loose rectilinear grid-like structure across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges present in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance crests to shadowed troughs immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark circular depression or mark located on the lower mid-flank, specifically indicated by an artificial black arrow overlay.
other_distinctive_markers: An artificial black arrow graphic superimposed on the image, pointing towards the lower flank posterior to the pectoral fin base.
